current_findings.finding: Captured active repository ruleset: zero approvals, no code-owner review, no last-push approval, squash and rebase allowed, strict/up-to-date disabled, and only one lockfile status check required.
current_findings.required_action: Make live enforcement match policy: strict aggregate gates, squash-only, signatures, no bypass, conversation resolution, and honest solo-operator/independent-review modes.

current_findings.finding: Captured active series-a ruleset: signatures and strict status checks exist, but zero approvals and only Gitleaks plus a lockfile check are required; a separate workflow protects frontier source pins.
current_findings.required_action: Add actual aggregate CI, backend, E2E, accessibility/performance, dependency, CodeQL, readiness, release-contract, and Hub-parity contexts after discovering exact names.

current_findings.finding: Captured organization default ruleset requires PRs and thread resolution but zero approvals, no code-owner/last-push approval, and no required status checks.
current_findings.required_action: Create tiered intended rulesets and a policy-as-code test against effective API readback for every repository.

controls: API-read every applicable ruleset and required workflow.
Strict up-to-date checks for T0/T1; no bypass or direct-main writes.
Squash-only promotion; signed commits/tags; thread resolution.
Independent non-author approval when available; expiring SOLO_OPERATOR_EXCEPTION otherwise.
Policy-as-code test fails when intended and effective rulesets diverge.
gates.name: Governance and effective control plane

controls: One package manager/lockfile per workspace.
Clean-clone install/build/test with deterministic generated files.
No unmanaged large binaries or build output in Git.
Actions and container bases are immutable pinned.
Build manifest binds source, toolchain, locks, and artifact digest.
gates.name: Clean clone, deterministic build, and repository hygiene
gates.objective: Clean clone, deterministic build, and repository hygiene

controls: Format, lint, typecheck, dependency boundaries, dead code, generated-code drift.
No T0/T1 circular dependencies.
Risk-critical authorization, tenancy, receipt, approval, rollback paths have direct tests.
Flaky tests have owner/expiry; retries collect evidence but never turn nondeterminism green.
One production:verify command emits a machine aggregate.
gates.name: Static quality, typing, architecture, and maintainability
gates.objective: Static quality, typing, architecture, and maintainability

controls: Playwright on Chromium, Firefox, WebKit.
Desktop/tablet and 390/375/320px viewports.
No uncaught errors, console errors, critical request failures, mixed content, broken links, or unexpected redirects.
Visual regression masks only declared dynamic regions.
Failed CI retains trace, screenshots, video, DOM, network, and exact revision.
gates.name: Frontend functional and journey verification

controls: Zero critical/serious axe violations and blocking Lighthouse accessibility.
Manual keyboard, focus, escape, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, reduced-motion and contrast review.
Accessible names, skip links, target sizes, labels, live regions.
Maps/3D have equivalent table/list summaries.
Current audit records route, browser and assistive-technology scope.
gates.name: Accessibility WCAG 2.2 AA

controls: Field p75: LCP <=2.5s, INP <=200ms, CLS <=0.1 by device class.
Production-build Lighthouse with at least three diagnostic runs.
No synchronous 3D/map/model inventory in the first fold.
Route JS/CSS/image/font budgets and regression limits.
Performance, best practices and SEO become blocking after baseline remediation.
gates.name: Frontend performance and user experience

controls: Product first fold states buyer, problem, Lyte outcome, proof and CTA.
Console, investor, estate, verifier, trust and research routes are separate.
a11oy.net is proof-first; Hugging Face is artifact-first.
No stale counts/status/product names or unsupported parity claims.
Changing claims are generated with source and freshness.
gates.name: Content design, information architecture, and truth
gates.objective: Content design, information architecture, and truth

controls: Canonical OpenAPI/JSON Schema and breaking-change diff.
Strict request/response validation, bounded bodies and pagination.
Stable error code plus request/trace/error IDs and source revision.
Idempotency for mutations; safe timeout/cancel/retry/backoff/circuit breaker/bulkhead.
Identity/tenant/operation-aware rate limits and tested deprecation windows.
gates.name: API contracts, validation, and compatibility

controls: Verify explicitly, least privilege, short-lived credentials, deny by default.
Tenant identity propagates through data, retrieval, cache, model/tool, receipt and telemetry.
Model output never grants authority.
Admin/destructive paths have step-up controls and audit.
Secrets/PII never appear in logs, traces, screenshots, errors or receipts.
ASVS L2 baseline and targeted L3 verification.
gates.name: Identity, tenancy, authorization, and data protection
gates.objective: Identity, tenancy, authorization, and data protection

controls: Durable governed storage is mandatory for production readiness.
Forward, rollback/roll-forward, compatibility and dirty-upgrade tests.
Backup/restore exercise with measured RPO/RTO draft.
Transactions, constraints, idempotency and concurrent writers tested.
Serving identity cannot edit/delete append-only evidence.
gates.name: Persistence, migrations, backup, and recovery

controls: Distinct startup/liveness/readiness.
Graceful shutdown/restart with no corrupt or duplicate operation.
Forecast and 2x load, burst, stress and soak tests.
Dependency outage, timeout, malformed/slow response, quota, disk-full and clock-skew tests.
Declared degraded modes and loop/cost/capacity guardrails.
gates.name: Reliability, capacity, degradation, and failure testing
gates.objective: Reliability, capacity, degradation, and failure testing

controls: OTel traces, metrics and logs with semantic conventions.
Trace browser -> API -> policy -> model -> tool -> approval -> receipt -> outcome.
SLOs approved only after baseline; no invented uptime.
Error-budget policy freezes nonessential change when exhausted.
Every alert ends in page, ticket or logging and has an owner.
gates.name: Observability, SLOs, error budgets, and alerting
gates.objective: Observability, SLOs, error budgets, and alerting

controls: Uniform debug bundle with IDs, exact revisions, sanitized logs, browser trace and replay fixture.
Contain/rollback before speculative repair.
Failing reproduction/regression test precedes fix where feasible.
Bisect/dependency-diff evidence.
Blameless postmortem and permanent control improvement.
gates.name: Debugging, incident response, and learning

controls: NIST SSDF outcome map and T0 threat model.
Secret scan/push protection, CodeQL/SAST, dependency review, vuln/license policy.
Pinned actions/bases and least-privilege workflow permissions.
SBOM and ML-BOM where applicable.
Generate and verify artifact attestation; immutable release and offline bundle.
gates.name: Secure software and supply chain

controls: Build once and promote exact artifact.
CI -> preview -> staging -> canary -> production.
Merge does not automatically mean global release.
Canary success/abort thresholds and automatic rollback/traffic removal.
Runtime readback binds artifact, policy, model/data and receipt.
gates.name: Release rings, canary, rollback, and post-deploy verification
gates.objective: Release rings, canary, rollback, and post-deploy verification

controls: No public pickle/joblib; no mutable trust_remote_code.
Weights/adapters/quantizations/kernels/recipes/aliases/roadmaps/history visibly distinct.
Cards include source, rights/license, intended use, limits, training/eval revisions and N.
Spaces bind exact source/deployment/runtime/readiness/accessibility/security.
One writer, exact-parent Hub PRs, immutable readback, red-team and drift gates.
gates.name: Hugging Face model, data, kernel, and Space controls
gates.objective: Hugging Face model, data, kernel, and Space controls

controls: One product hierarchy and primary vertical.
Three deterministic positive/negative demonstrations.
Architecture, data flow, threat model, SLO draft, release, incident, support and compatibility.
Current risk/claim/gap/dependency/license/data-rights registers.
Clean-machine governed decision and offline verification.
gates.name: Investor, customer, and contributor diligence

leader_processes.pattern: Independent verification and gradual release through rings.
leader_processes.szl_translation: Exact-head review plus build-once preview, staging, canary, and production promotion.

leader_processes.pattern: Consistent operational excellence, security, reliability, performance, cost, sustainability review.
leader_processes.szl_translation: One evidence-linked architecture and operations scorecard.

leader_processes.pattern: Prepare, protect, produce well-secured software, and respond to vulnerabilities.
leader_processes.szl_translation: SSDF mapping for T0 and AI-specific model/data practices.

leader_processes.pattern: Standardized verification of web application security controls.
leader_processes.szl_translation: ASVS L2 baseline; targeted L3 for identity, approval, receipt, and admin paths.

leader_processes.pattern: Dependency review, immutable releases, SBOM, attestations, and verification.
leader_processes.szl_translation: Build once, SPDX/CycloneDX, attest and verify before deploy, offline verification bundle.
WCAG 2.2 AA automated and manual evidence for current routes.

leader_processes.pattern: Field measurement of loading, responsiveness, and stability.
leader_processes.szl_translation: RUM p75 LCP/INP/CLS plus production-build diagnostics and budgets.

leader_processes.pattern: Cross-browser journeys and CI trace-based debugging.
leader_processes.szl_translation: Chromium/Firefox/WebKit with traces, video, screenshots, console/network evidence.

leader_processes.pattern: Vendor-neutral traces, metrics, logs, and semantic conventions.
leader_processes.szl_translation: One context from browser through API, policy, model, tool, approval, receipt, outcome.
Distinct dependency-aware probes on every runtime.

leader_processes.pattern: Safe formats, signed revisions, scanning, intended-use/limitations/evaluation metadata.
leader_processes.szl_translation: No public joblib/pickle, immutable remote code, generated passports and eval-bound cards.
